import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.

L'altro banca dac deve essere in esecuzione e ragiuntarbile (porte predefinite: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; sovrascrivi cun WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Al termine, punta MONGO_URL all'altro banca dac e riavvia WeKan (su Snap: snap set wekan banca dac=ferretdb o =mongodb).

Las agiuntas ed ils avatars vegnan spustads da la banca da datas en ils ordinaturs files/attachments e files/avatars dal grain. Qua vegn mussà sche questa migraziun è reussida e quant spazi sin il disc che las veglias datotecas brutas da MongoDB occupan anc en il grain. Ti pos stizzar questas datotecas brutas per liberar spazi.

cards-loading-description: WeKan chargia automaticamain las cartas da las tabellas: ina gronda tabella (sur la limita da grondezza) chargia mo las cartas actualmain visiblas (scorrer senza fin) ed in dumber actualisà en temp real. Uschia resta ella svelta e dovra main memoria e ladezza da banda. Tabellas pli pitschnas chargian tut las cartas per in’utilisaziun simpla cun tut las funcziuns. I na dat nagut da configurar. Ils operaturs pon tuttina sfurzar in modus cun las variablas d’ambient CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) e CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.

Riciaria su le tabellai aperte dopo aver cambiato questa impostazion.

Quai renda visibel il cuntegn zuppà — commentaris HTML (<!-- -->), la destinaziun da colliaziuns markdown, JavaScript e mintga auter code — uschia che tut il code è adina visibel, na po betg vegnir cliccà e na vegn betg exequì. Sco standard è l’opziun deactivada, uschia che markdown vegn represchentà normalmain.
disable-all-import-description: Sche activà, èn tut las funcziuns d’import deactivadas: importar ina tabella da WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea e Forgejo, sco era clonar ina tabella. Las opziuns dal menu d’import èn zuppadas ed il server refusescha mintga dumonda d’import. Sco standard è l’opziun deactivada.
disable-all-export-description: Sche activà, èn tut las funcziuns d’export deactivadas: exportar ina tabella sco WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard u a NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, ed exportar singulas agiuntas. Las opziuns dal menu d’export èn zuppadas ed il server refusescha mintga dumonda d’export. Sco standard è l’opziun deactivada.
disable-import-avatars-description: Sche activà, na vegnan avatars (maletgs da profil dals utilisaders) mai importads. Quai cumpiglia l’import JSON da WeKan, l’import da Trello e la sincronisaziun dad avatars da purschiders d’identitad externs tar l’annunzia (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Nums ed autras datas vegnan tuttina importads; mo ils avatars vegnan sursiglids. Sco standard è l’opziun deactivada.
disable-export-avatars-description: Sche activà, na vegnan avatars (maletgs da profil dals utilisaders) mai inclus tar l’export d’ina tabella (export JSON e CSV da WeKan). Nums d’utilisader ed autras datas vegnan tuttina exportads; mo ils avatars vegnan omess. Sco standard è l’opziun deactivada.
anonymize-import-users-description: Sche activà, remplazza l’import d’ina tabella JSON da WeKan il num d’utilisader, il num cumplet e las inizialas da mintga utilisader importà cun substituts numerads (user1, user2, ...), allontanescha ses avatar e riscriva las menziuns @username (ed ils champs dumandà-da / attribuì-da) en il text da las cartas e dals commentaris importads. Nagina identitad reala d’utilisader da la tabella da funtauna vegn memorisada. Il pled "user" suonda la lingua da la persuna che importa. Sco standard è l’opziun deactivada.
anonymize-export-users-description: Sche activà, remplazza l’export d’ina tabella il num d’utilisader, il num cumplet e las inizialas da mintga utilisader exportà cun substituts numerads (user1, user2, ...), allontanescha ses avatar e riscriva las menziuns @username (ed ils champs dumandà-da / attribuì-da) en il text da las cartas e dals commentaris. La datoteca exportada na cuntegna nagina identitad reala d’utilisader. Il pled "user" suonda la lingua da la persuna che exporta. Sco standard è l’opziun deactivada.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Vuls ti propi anonimisar quest conto? Quai remplazza permanentamain il num d’utilisader, il num cumplet e l’adressa dad e-mail cun valurs anonimisadas, allontanescha l’avatar e deactivescha l’annunzia. Cuntrari al stizzar mantegnan las tabellas, cartas e commentaris lur cronologia e mussan vinavant quest conto, ma anonimisà. Questa acziun na po betg vegnir fatga enavos.

Las activitads pon tuttina vegnir registradas (nun ch’ellas sajan era deactivadas sura); mo las notificaziuns vegnan supprimidas. Sco standard è l’opziun deactivada.

backup-description: Crear ina copia da segirezza da las agiuntas, dals avatars e/u da las datas (tut las collecziuns da text che n’èn betg agiuntas u avatars). Il .zip vegn tramess directamain al deposit tschernì — senza datoteca temporara — sco backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, cun YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars e /data. Deposits en il cloud (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) utiliseschan las credenzialas configuradas en lur registers da deposit.

Il backup di un'organisaziun contiene le sue tabellai e tutto ciò che vi si trova, inclusi i loro injuntes — ma nessun cont utent e deguna impostazion dell'istanza, perché queste ie condivise da tut las le organisaziuns. stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync operations that cannot be replayed
stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.

interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.

interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Keep this partial board as it is? Nothing is removed, and the import is no longer listed here.

interrupted-import-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
